rules.statement: In a test project, a property-based test (such as an FsCheck property returning a boolean) checks exactly one behavior: split a property that combines several checks into one property per behavior, and don't check anything the test name doesn't mention.
rules.why: When a property that returns one combined boolean fails, FsCheck reports only that it was false, not which of the combined behaviors broke.
rules.check: Look for property tests whose returned boolean joins several conditions with && (for example, order plus exception content plus exception type), whose names join outcomes with "And", or that check state (such as IsDisposed) the name doesn't mention.
